news.headline: H100 Group Partners With Coinbase for Balance Sheet Management
news.summary: Swedish health technology company H100 Group has partnered with Coinbase to provide institutional custody, trading, and financing services for its corporate balance sheet.

news.headline: Coinbase and Broadridge Publish Proposed Standard for Onchain Shareholder Communications
news.summary: Coinbase and Broadridge Financial Solutions have introduced a proposed industry standard for onchain shareholder communications alongside the launch of a new data oracle.
